description: This file defines a Java interface 'UserRepository' extending JpaRepository, providing methods for accessing User entities in a database, specifically methods to find users by username and email.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: A JPA repository interface for User entities with custom finder methods.

methods.name: findByUsername
methods.description: Retrieves a User wrapped in Optional based on the username.

methods.name: findByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves a User wrapped in Optional based on the email.
